layers.name: guarded_contact_override
layers.when: same-id train copy reconstructs the visible prefix within limit
layers.method: TVT = ref_tvt - (Z - formation) + offset, interpolated over MD

layers.name: physics_ml_gated_blend
layers.method: TVT_blend = weight*PF + (1-weight)*ML; PF = numpy likelihood-weighted ensemble (U=TVT+Z vs typewell GR, IRLS projection), ML = offline distilled GBRT base predictor (src/ml_predictor.py); degrades to whichever side is finite
layers.blend_weight_selection: grid 0.50..1.00 argmin RMSE on leak-free fold-1 toe-holdout (disjoint from fold-0 confirm), frozen before reading fold-0 targets

layers.name: recency_weighted_offset_trend
layers.when: particle filter cannot run (e.g. degenerate typewell)
